description: Official portrait of Gina Haspel, Director of the CIA (2018-2021). She wears a light blue jacket and stands in front of the U.S. flag and the CIA seal on the wall behind her. Filename in the archive is Haspel.jpg.

Official portrait of David Bowdich, FBI Deputy Director (2018-2021), in a dark suit with a red striped tie in front of the U.S. flag. This is his widely published FBI official photo; the archive filename is David_Bowdich.jpg.

Photograph of a swearing-in ceremony. An older bearded man in a dark suit raises his right hand with his left hand on a thick book held by a woman in a gray dress, while a female judge in black robes administers the oath; a U.S. flag stands at left. The archive filename labels the image Bishop.jpg, but no one in the photo is named on-screen and the participants could not be independently identified.
flags: Filename claims the subject is named Bishop; identity unverified
